plain_scalar_hash_sweep.method: Every line of the form `key: value` whose value is a plain scalar (not quoted, not a block scalar) was scanned for the substring ' #', which opens a YAML comment and silently truncates the field.
plain_scalar_hash_sweep.why_this_check_exists: Parsing is not sufficient. Earlier in this program a reviewer's 74-character verdict parsed cleanly as a 16-character string because of an unquoted space-hash, misrepresenting that reviewer inside a disagreement record.

declared_versus_committed.reason: INT-BATCH007-T. This receipt must record commit e109e621's SHA, so it cannot be among the paths that commit changes. No archive task can both satisfy verify_archive's declared-equals-committed check and record its own commit SHA. The receipt therefore lands in the immediately following commit, exactly as the TASK-20260729-006 run-package receipt did at c3e2f453 over 2fb2bb7a.
declared_versus_committed.not_a_scope_overrun: The commit changed a STRICT SUBSET of the declared set. No undeclared path was staged, no path was deleted, and no macOS AppleDouble sidecar was committed. This is the opposite failure mode from BATCH-010, which declared 7 paths against a 195-path commit.
